title: n1 editor phase 5 landscape workspace

commit.merge_subject: merge: n1 editor phase 5 landscape workspace

description:
Owner request 2026-11-11d sections 17.3 + 18.

- Landscape panel hide/reopen: the right column's header carries a
  hide IconButton (vendored Material Symbols right_panel_close
  glyph); hidden, the preview column widens to the FULL width
  (OrientationLayout.previewWidthFraction with panelVisible=false
  returns 1f — the horizontal expansion section 17.3 names) and a
  scrimmed reopen chip appears on the preview's right edge, the
  same scrimmed IconButton group as the corner controls. panelVisible
  is rememberSaveable: a rotation keeps the panel where the user
  left it. The portrait sheet's drag-handle collapse is untouched
  and independent.
- Orientation state preservation (sections 17.3 + 18: 'Do not reset
  editing state or playback when switching orientation'):
  MainActivity now handles orientation|screenSize|screenLayout|
  keyboardHidden itself, so the system does NOT recreat
changed: feat: landscape panel hide and rotation safety
